notes: SIUBEN (Sistema Único de Beneficiarios, Dominican Republic) exposes a private partner API: no public docs, no reachable Swagger, and its hosts are not reachable from outside the country; OpenFn's adaptor PR says the docs were shared privately. The adaptor is a thin wrapper: execute() POSTs {username,password} to {baseUrl}/authenticate and stores response.body.Token as a bearer token, then exposes only generic http.get/http.request (ast.json has no named API operations), so 'full' here means every route we can evidence, not a vendor inventory. Modelled: POST /authenticate (adaptor source, confirmed) and, from an independent public C# client, POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/Data/get/{cedula} and PUT /api/Data/update/{cedula} with that client's typed Beneficiario fields; each operation carries x-openfn-source. That client may target a different SIUBEN deployment or version (its login route and token casing differ from the adaptor's), so those three routes are best-effort. The July 2026 stub's /beneficiarios, /hogares, /hogares/{id}/miembros and /icv/{id} routes were invented and have been removed, as has the issue's placeholder GET /casos.
